This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
SRAM hard macro (src/mem/mem.v instance u_mem.sram), IHP SG13CMOS5L.
Files come from the PDK the flow installs (sg13cmos5l_sram links to sg13g2_sram,
the same macro), so they always match what precheck checks against.
FS (flipped vertically): the 70 signal pins on the macro's bottom edge face up,
towards the logic and the tile's I/O pins on the top edge. x = 3.36 phases the
macro's Metal4 supply columns onto the PDN grid below; y is a row boundary,
leaving rows under the macro for the grid stripes that feed VDDARRAY!.
PDN: CMOS5L tiles have Metal4 only (no TopMetal), so the grid is vertical Metal4
stripes and the macro's supplies are vertical Metal4 columns. The macro's left
array has VDD/VSS column pairs 5.62 apart repeating every 11.24 (LEF). Width 2.1
fits inside the 2.81 columns, spacing 3.52 gives the 5.62 pair distance, pitch
33.72 = 3 x 11.24, and offset 6.145 puts stripe centres at 2.88 + 6.145 = 9.025 =
3.36 + 5.665, the first VDD column's centre (and 33.72 later, the fourth's).
pdn_cfg.tcl bridges those stripes to the columns across the macro halo and fails
the run if any supply pin is left unconnected or a stripe crosses the macro.
SRAM GDS has no PR boundary layer; read full GDS instead of blackbox
SRAM macro internals trigger DRC in Magic and overlap reports at the
VDD!/VDDARRAY! boundary (known, per the CMOS5L SRAM walkthrough); precheck
runs its own DRC on the final GDS
Blackbox SRAM macros during SPICE extraction for LVS, as the macros are not LVS clean
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
